Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +32

STATISTICS: Str 10, Dex 20, Con 18, Int 24, Wis 16, Cha 20

Feats Alertness, Combat Casting, Dark Focus, Dark Penetration, Empower Spell, Greater Dark Focus, Greater Spell Focus (dark, element), Greater Spell Penetration, Intensified Spell, Maximize Spell, Silent Spell, Spell Penetration, Spell Focus (dark, element), Quicken Spell
Skills Acrobatics +34, Bluff +35, Escape Artist +35, Knowledge (arcana) +36, Knowledge (local) +36, Knowledge (nature) +36, Perception +32, Sense Motive +32, Spellcraft +35, Stealth +35
Languages Aquan, Slyvan, Undercommon + 5 others (DM's choice)
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Fiery Storm Dome (su) All creatures within a 30-foot radius from ainsel must make a DC 30 Will save or have their fire, ice, lightning, and wind resistance dropped by 15 for 1d6 rounds. Whether or not the save is successful, that creature cannot be affected again by the same ainsel's fiery storm aqua dome ability for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Liquid Form (su) An ainsel is always in liquid form. She gains immunity to critical hits, poison, and sneak attacks. She also has DR/15 magic. She retains her own base speed, and her swim speed doubles to 120 feet.

Malediction (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, an ainsel can release malevolence from within draining the health of all nearby enemies within a 30-ft.-radius spread. An ainsel deals 12d6 points of shadow damage and is healed by half of the total damage done unless those in the area must make a Fortitude save (DC 32) to negate the heal affect and take half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33).

Mesmerizing Voice (su) Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Ainsel sings a mesmerizing song that charms all those nearby her. Creatures within 30 feet of ainsel must make a Will save (DC 32) or be charmed for 1 minute. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
Unearthly Grace (su) An ainsel adds her Charisma modifier as a racial bonus on all her saving throws and as a deflection bonus to her AC.
DESCRIPTION: A spirit that disguises itself as a beautiful woman. It favors strong-willed humans, devouring their souls for sustenance. As long as its victim's will is strong this spirit will attack both saints and villains indiscriminately. Apparently virtuous and evil emotions are equally nutritious when converted to energy. The more souls Ainsel consumes, the more powerful the spirit grows.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
